info.title: Solrouter Agent Privacy API
info.description: Private Solana swaps and encrypted inference for AI agents. Mainnet only. Swaps route through the Umbra Privacy mixer + Jupiter; inference is Arcium-encrypted end-to-end and processed inside an Intel TDX enclave. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Solana, `X-PAYMENT` header) or with a Solrouter API key (`sk_solrouter_*`).

tags.name: Swaps
tags.description: Private token swaps. Quote first, then run a one-shot ephemeral-wallet swap (Mode B) where the agent signs its own funding tx. No managed custody required.

tags.name: Managed Wallets
tags.description: Provision a Solrouter-custodied Umbra wallet (Mode A), fund it, swap from it, and read its audit log. The wallet keypair is envelope-encrypted server-side; the agent never holds keys.

tags.name: Private Balance
tags.description: Encrypted-balance operations on a managed wallet: encrypt a public balance into ciphertext, shield + unlink to a fresh address, withdraw back to a public address, and read the encrypted snapshot.

tags.name: Inference
tags.description: Cryptographically private, OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Prompts are Arcium-encrypted client-side; Solrouter never sees plaintext.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Poll the state of an async swap/balance session and fetch its on-chain attestation once settled.

Quote.description: Private-swap quote with Solrouter spread applied and anonymity-set guidance.

expectedOut.description: output amount after Solrouter spread, base units

rawJupiterOut.description: raw Jupiter output before spread, base units

bucketed.description: true when amount snaps to a standard denomination bucket

example.privacyNotes: amount snaps to a standard denomination, a strong anonymity set

Session.description: State of a swap/balance session. Poll until `state` is settled.

state.description: e.g. running, funded, swapping, settled, failed

SessionAck.description: Acknowledgement for an async operation. Poll GET /agents/v1/sessions/{id} for progress.

get.description: Price a private swap before executing it. Returns the expected output after Solrouter's spread plus anonymity-set guidance: whether the amount snaps to a standard denomination bucket (strong privacy) or is an off-bucket amount with a unique on-chain fingerprint.

get.summary: Pool depth for a denomination bucket
get.description: Inspect the anonymity set for a standard denomination bucket before swapping: how many recent deposits share that bucket. A deeper pool means a larger crowd to hide in.

post.summary: Begin a one-shot ephemeral-wallet private swap (Mode B)
post.description: Start a private swap that runs through a throwaway ephemeral wallet, with no managed custody. Solrouter returns an unsigned `fundingTx`; the agent signs and broadcasts it, then calls `POST /swaps/oneshot/{id}/execute` to kick off the swap orchestrator.

payerPubkey.description: the agent's wallet that funds the swap

destinationPubkey.description: where the swapped tokens are delivered

201.description: Session created; sign + broadcast fundingTx, then call /execute

fundingTx.description: base64 unsigned tx for the agent to sign

400.description: Missing fields, off-bucket amount, or non-positive amount

post.summary: Submit fundingTxSig and start the swap orchestrator
post.description: After signing + broadcasting the funding tx from the one-shot session, submit its signature here to start the swap.

404.description: Session not found or already executed

post.summary: Provision a managed Umbra wallet (Mode A)
post.description: Create a Solrouter-custodied Umbra wallet. The keypair is generated server-side and envelope-encrypted (AES-256-GCM), so the agent never holds private keys. Fund the returned `umbraAddress`, then run swaps and encrypted-balance operations against the wallet id.

webhookSecret.description: optional HMAC secret for webhook signing

example.fundingHint: send SOL or SPL tokens to umbraAddress to fund this wallet

post.summary: Run a private swap from a managed wallet (Mode A)
post.description: Execute a private swap funded by a managed wallet's balance. Returns a session id to poll; no client-side signing needed.

post.summary: Build an unsigned funding tx for the agent to sign
post.description: Returns an unsigned base64 transaction that moves tokens from the agent's own wallet into the managed wallet. The agent signs and broadcasts it.

get.description: Chronological audit log of every operation on a managed wallet (created, swap, encrypt, shield, withdraw), newest first.

post.summary: Encrypt a public balance into an encrypted balance
post.description: One tx, ~10s. Funds stay at the same Umbra address but the running balance + future activity become ciphertext on chain. No mixer, no fresh address. Use when you want amount-privacy without breaking address linkability.

post.summary: Shield + unlink: mixer round-trip to a fresh address
post.description: Four txs, ~60s. Public balance enters the Umbra mixer, a claim breaks the on-chain link, then withdraw + transfer delivers to a FRESH destination. Source and destination both appear on-chain but with no link between them. Use when you want destination unlinkability without converting tokens.

post.summary: Withdraw from encrypted balance to a public address
post.description: Move funds out of a managed wallet's encrypted balance to a public Solana address.

get.description: Decrypt and return the managed wallet's encrypted balance for one or more mints (comma-separated).

post.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions. The prompt MUST be Arcium-encrypted client-side using `@solrouter/sdk`'s `encryptPrompt()` helper; the encrypted prompt is processed and the response returned encrypted, without Solrouter ever seeing plaintext. Pay-per-call x402 ($0.005 USDC flat per call). For per-token internal-credit billing with an API key, use POST /api/v1/chat/completions instead.

get.description: Fetch the current state of any swap/balance session. Poll until `state` is `settled` (or `failed`).

get.summary: On-chain attestation for a settled session
get.description: Once a session settles, fetch its on-chain attestation PDA + a snapshot of the swap (mints, amounts, final tx) with Solscan links.

404.description: Session not found, or no attestation yet
